The natural habitat of these crabs is so polluted and devoid of shells that they've been forced to take shelter in discarded goblin munitions. Venture Company workers might use these creatures for some impromptu demolition. One must be careful to remove all the powder, or they will lose a hand while cooking it. Boosting is a player‑driven practice in World of Warcraft in which a high-level character (typically a mage or paladin in Classic) to level up a lower level character, or a more‑geared character (typically in retail) completes content on behalf of another player in exchange for in‑game gold or other compensation. Boosting can occur in dungeons, raids, PvP, or open-world content. Blizzard has historically tolerated individual boosting while prohibiting large‑scale commercial organizations that coordinate or advertise such services for RMT (real-money trading), which is against the Terms of Service. The Boskroot fungarians are a group of fungarians found in Boskroot Basin and Fungal Folly on the Isle of Dorn. They infested the forest following Woldkeeper Freydrin's shutdown, spreading their mycotic corruption throughout the woods and even afflicting the animals there, like the Mycotic Shalehorns and Infected Peafowls whom they use as mounts and pets, respectively. Many dead Boskroot Lashbanes can be found scattered around the woods, presumably killed by the fungarians who seem to have risen some of them into their service. The Boskroot fungarians also apparently consume Boskroot Caps, which U'llort the Self-Exiled found disgusting, leading to their self-exile.U'llort the Self-Exiled#Quo
